name: RTI-121
summary: (–)-2β-Carboisopropoxy-3β-(4-iodophenyl)tropane (RTI-4229-121, IPCIT) is a stimulant drug used in scientific research, which was developed in the early 1990s. RTI-121 is a phenyltropane based, highly selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor and is derived from methylecgonidine.

pharmacology.text: RTI-121 is a phenyltropane based, highly selective dopamine reuptake inhibitor and is derived from methylecgonidine.

uses.text: RTI-121 is mainly used in scientific research into the dopamine reuptake transporter. It is more selective for the dopamine transporter than other DAT radioligands such as β-CIT, and so has less nonspecific binding and produces "cleaner" images.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of this kind can cause a racing heart, high blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness, overheating and paranoia, and repeated use can lead to compulsive redosing and dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、高血壓、焦慮、失眠、體溫過高和偏執，反覆使用可能導致強迫性追加和依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、高血压、焦虑、失眠、体温过高和偏执，反复使用可能导致强迫性追加和依赖。

fact.en: RTI-121 carries an iodine atom, which can be made radioactive. Labelled this way, it is used in brain imaging to map dopamine transporters.
fact.zh: RTI-121 帶有一個碘原子，可以製成放射性的形式。經過這樣標記後，它被用於腦部影像檢查，以描繪多巴胺轉運蛋白的分布。
fact.zhHans: RTI-121 带有一个碘原子，可以制成放射性的形式。经过这样标记后，它被用于脑部影像检查，以描绘多巴胺转运蛋白的分布。
